================================================================================
Create a role
================================================================================

CREATE ROLE jonathan LOGIN;
CREATE USER davide WITH PASSWORD 'jw8s0F4';
CREATE ROLE miriam WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'jw8s0F4' VALID UNTIL '2005-01-01';
CREATE ROLE admin WITH CREATEDB CREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER CONNECTION LIMIT 10;

GRANT USAGE ON FOREIGN SERVER s TO u;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON LARGE OBJECT 1234 TO u;
GRANT SET, ALTER SYSTEM ON PARAMETER work_mem TO u;
GRANT MAINTAIN ON t TO u;

================================================================================

================================================================================

REVOKE ADMIN OPTION FOR a FROM b GRANTED BY c RESTRICT;
